selection_disclosure: CLAHE and existing final NR-mono selected after seeing the four-family study; this is not the original primary-model test. No new model or CLAHE parameter fit.
eligibility_before_outcomes: All locally available LOLv2 Real Train689 and Synthetic Train900 pairs not documented as previously evaluated scenes; exclude known247SQUARE RealTrain identities and normal-reference thumbnail correlations>=0.9 with LOL485, SQUARE normal references and both original LOLv2Test100 sets. Reference-only classifier freezes exclusions/groups before any new enhancement score/quality. No minimum/maximum brightness or quality-based exclusion.
within_pool_groups: Same equalised48x32 grayscale correlation>=.9 connected components; retain all eligible files and weight groups equally. Subsets named unseen_pairs, not the official benchmark test split.
primary_model: Existing released NR-mono; code/hash from models.json final.
preprocessing: Existing256bilinearfloat32+exposed(low,1) pipeline, no additional synthetic exposure/noise.
frozen_controls: From completed LOL-only CONTROL_FREEZE: clip4 trainingconstant; brightness target.15. No updates from new images. NR-free, BrightnessCorrection_lam01, Linear3, Linear4, maxentropy,brightness.45,brightness_tuned all unchanged. Test-bestconstant andperimageLPIPSoracle descriptive only.
analysis: Equal reference-group means; 2,000 bootstrap draws, seed 20261030 plus sorted-domain index. NR-mono compared with training-fixed, default, Linear3, Linear4, RF3 and RF4 in two domains: Holm correction across 12 sign-flip tests. Domains with fewer than 20 groups remain descriptive and contribute p=1.
interpretation: A confirmed domain-specific useful CLAHE selector requires >=.005 LPIPS gain vs both trainingfixed anddefault withHolm p<.05, and consistent gain on at least one ofVGG/DISTS. Linear comparisons assess additional fuzzy value separately. PSNR/SSIM tradeoffs explicitly reported; nohuman-quality or universalgeneralisation claim.
